Our salon is clean and hygienic, with a huge variety of colors, and our regulars keep coming back for relaxing pedicures, foot massages and thin, natural-looking acrylics. Our techs include Ann, Lee, Joe, Kenny, Kevin and Kim.

reviews.text: My wife and I both got a nice relaxing pedicure on vacation! I mean, when she uses that buffer kind of roughly, I'm crawling up the back of the chair... But my feet feel so nice now! The foot massage was wonderful. Thank you!

reviews.text: Lee did an exceptional service, my feet are so clean, relaxed and painted! I’m so excited they look great! I’m falling asleep being so comfortable and relaxed I couldn’t help it!! I’m coming back for more !!!

reviews.text: Ann did my pedicure and my manicure! Not only did she do such a stunning job, she was so sweet and kind. I really enjoyed our time together and our little chats :) she’s an absolute doll and truly made my nail appointment an experience. Please please please go here and ask for her if she’s in! Calling ahead is a good idea to make sure she can take you. Thank you, Ann!
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: I have finally made Napa Valley Nails my place !! My experience has always been pleasurable. Anna is so sweet and does an amazing and detailed job.
